steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Create the basic HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript files for the web application.

steps.title: Configure Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Add the Tailwind CSS CDN to index.html for utility-first styling.

steps.title: Implement Responsive Header
steps.description: Design a responsive navigation bar with a logo and menu items using Tailwind CSS.

steps.title: Create Hero Section
steps.description: Develop a prominent hero section with a catchy headline, subtext, and a primary call-to-action button.

steps.title: Add Feature Showcase
steps.description: Design a section to highlight key features or benefits of the product/service using a grid layout with icons and descriptions.

steps.title: Include Testimonials Section
steps.description: Integrate a section to display customer testimonials or social proof to build trust.

steps.title: Implement Secondary Call-to-Action
steps.description: Add another call-to-action section before the footer to encourage user engagement.

steps.title: Design Responsive Footer
steps.description: Create a clean and informative footer with copyright information and potential navigation links.

steps.title: Enhance Mobile Responsiveness
steps.description: Review and refine all sections to ensure optimal display and user experience on various screen sizes.

steps.title: Add Dynamic Elements (Optional)
steps.description: Implement simple JavaScript for interactive elements like a mobile menu toggle or scroll animations.

steps.title: Integrate Placeholder Images
steps.description: Use dynamic image URLs for visual elements to make the landing page more engaging.

steps.title: Final Review and Polish
steps.description: Perform a comprehensive review of the design, functionality, and code quality across all files.

steps.title: Building landingpage
steps.description: The landing page web application is now complete and ready for deployment.
